submission_note: WBG-3 supervised multi-physics detector, dotted clear2 37654, zeros no NaN

registry.gate: gems57 literal per-raster (Euclidean 3px dot overlap <=0.70 and |Spearman| <=0.90), no density exemption
registry.scope: nine focus-site champion artifacts only (fetched from pinned GitHub commits, decoded positives verified vs registry/wbg2_calibration.json). A full-registry literal scan including registered dense continuous surfaces blocks any sparse field by construction (vendor/gems57/uniqueness.py docstring); that is reported, not exempted.

hypothesis: WBG-3: supervised multi-physics fault detector (official 19-band GeoDAWN stack + 3DEP LiDAR scarp + GeoDAWN radiometrics + local lineament texture) with catalogue-clearance dotted emission
mechanism: HGB trained on visible catalogue pixels learns the joint geophysical expression of mapped faults; dotted emission (>=3 px spacing, >2 px from catalogue, 37,654 dots) converts the surface to a max-cover-style field that does not retrace known faults, which earn no credit against expert-mapped new-fault truth.
named_non_fault_mimic: Range-front alluvial aprons and lithologic contacts produce coincident gravity/magnetic/basement steps without faulting; pluvial shoreline benches mimic scarps in the LiDAR stack.

holdout.benchmark_note: GEMSDOE24 S3DEP1, same evaluator, from evidence/benchmarks/gemsdoe24_s3dep1_run_card_20261026.json; its fold masks are not published, so paired replay is unavailable and the promotion gate fails closed.

leakage_canary.ir_wbg3_01: v1 catalogue-distance leakage found, fixed, and rerun; see research/04_wbg3_hypotheses_20261027.md

score_estimate.method: cross-fitted HOLDOUT-DTI 0.13823 x live/holdout ratios of the only two detector-family artifacts with both numbers (GEMSDOE24: 0.2477/0.17183=1.442; GEMSDOE25: 0.2600/0.16163=1.609), interval widened +-15%
caveats: n=2 anchors, both OWNER-REPORTED live values without organizer receipts
live truth is expert-mapped new faults, not withheld catalogue faults; the ratio is a ranking device, not a forecast
